model_output:
```sql
WITH orleans_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Orleans' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
orleans_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM orleans_geom), TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM orleans_geom))
),
orleans_slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF', TRUE) AS slope_rast
  FROM orleans_dem
)
SELECT
  MIN(value) AS flattest_slope
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).*
  FROM orleans_slope_raster
) AS slope_values;
```
